entities.summary: Morgan Hen ab Owain or Morgan Hen, first known as Morgan ab Owain of Gwent and also known as Moragn Hen Fawr, was the king of Morgannwg. He ruled Gwent from c. 930 and Morgannwg from AD 942 to 974.
